statement: ∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K), letI := c; letI : Algebra (LR.R p) K := rho.toAlgebra; letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p; ∀ (s : Module (ZMod p) (LR.QMR p M)), letI := s; ∀ (t : LR.TransportData K p M) (b : ℂ) (d : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M)) (hd : ∀ i, (d i : V) = b • LR.vec y v i.val) (beta : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) K (LR.VK K M)) (hb : ∀ i, t.first (beta i) = TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) 1 (d i)) (ec : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) ℂ V) (hc : ∀ i, ec i = LR.vec y v i.val) (i j : Fin (l+1)) (aR : Module.End (LR.R p) (LR.MR p M)) (ha : ∀ m, (aR m : V) = LR.unit l ec i j m), ∀ z, t.first (LR.unit l beta i j z) = aR.baseChange K (t.first z)
proof:
classical
intro c rho
letI := c
letI : Algebra (LR.R p) K := rho.toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
intro s
letI := s
intro t b d hd beta hb ec hc i j aR ha
have he : ∀ k, aR (d k) = if j = k then d i else 0 := by
  intro k
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [ha, hd, ← hc k, map_smul]
  split_ifs with hk
  · subst k
    simp [LR.unit, hd, hc]
  · simp [LR.unit, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Ne.symm hk]
have hm : t.first.toLinearMap.comp (LR.unit l beta i j) = (aR.baseChange K).comp t.first.toLinearMap := by
  apply beta.ext
  intro k
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [hb, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, he]
  by_cases hk : j = k
  · subst k
    simp [LR.unit, hb]
  · simp [LR.unit, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Ne.symm hk, hk]
intro z
exact LinearMap.congr_fun hm z
